titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Queen's Vow and Her Wish to Return (ch. 28)
part: ch. 28 — The Queen's Vow and Her Wish to Return
about: Solomon answers that God alone is to be worshipped, and that the Ark of the God of Israel was truly given to Israel, created before creation, with his commandments sent down in writing. The Queen vows to leave the sun and worship Israel's God, asks that the Ark be her lady, and thanks God for bringing her to hear the king. After six months she sends word that she wants to return home. Solomon, seeing her beauty, hopes for offspring, and the chapter defends his many wives by Genesis 22:17 and by the difference between the old law of the flesh and the Christian rule of one wife, as the apostles and Paul taught.

sentences.t: ፳፰ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ አዘዛ ፡ ለንግሥት ።
sentences.l: 28. Concerning how he-commanded-her to-queen.
sentences.i: Chapter 28: How He Commanded the Queen
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፳፰ is 20 + 8 = 28. በእንተ 'concerning' takes a construct; here it governs the clause ዘከመ 'how, in the way that' (ዘ- relative + ከመ 'as'). አዘዛ is አዘዘ 'he commanded' (root ʾ-z-z; the initial አ belongs to the root, as in ትእዛዝ 'commandment', and is not a causative prefix); the final -ዛ is the last radical ዘ plus the suffix -ኣ 'her'. ለንግሥት is not the object marker: it restates the pronoun in apposition, 'her, the Queen', as in ይቤላ ለንግሥት in ch. 27 (ንግሥት is the title, not a name).

sentences.t: ወዓውሥአ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወይቤላ ፡ በአማን ፡ ርቱዕ ፡ ይሰግዱ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለዘ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ኵሎ ፤ ሰማየ ፡ ወምድረ ፤ ወባሕረ ፡ ወየብሰ ፤ ፀሐየ ፡ ወወርኀ ፤ ከዋክብተ ፡ ወጸዳላተ ፤ ዕፀወ ፡ ወአእባነ ፤ እንስሳ ፡ ወአዕዋፈ ፤ ዓራዊተ ፡ ወሐርገጻተ ፤ ዓሣተ ፡ ወዐናብርተ ፤ ቢሐተ ፡ ወዐንጐጓተ ፤ መባርቅተ ፡ ወፀዓዓተ ፤ ደመናተ ፡ ወነጐድጓደ ፤ ሠናያነ ፡ ወእኩያነ ።
sentences.l: And-answered king and-he-said-to-her: In-truth right they-worship to-God, to-who he-made all; heaven and-earth; and-sea and-dry-land; sun and-moon; stars and-lights(?); trees and-stones; cattle and-birds; wild-beasts and-creeping-things(?); fish and-sea-monsters(?); ቢሐተ(?) and-ዐንጐጓተ(?); lightnings and-ፀዓዓተ(?); clouds and-thunder; good-ones and-evil-ones.
sentences.i: The king answered and said to her: "It is truly right to worship God, who made everything: heaven and earth; sea and dry land; sun and moon; stars and lights; trees and stones; cattle and birds; wild beasts and creeping things; fish and sea monsters; ቢሐተ [biḥätä] (?) and ዐንጐጓተ [ʿängʷägʷatä] (?); lightning and ፀዓዓተ [ṣ́äʿaʿatä] (?); clouds and thunder; the good and the evil."
sentences.n: ወ- 'and' on the verbs ዓውሥአ (አውሥአ, causative: 'he answered') and ይቤላ (ይቤ 'he said' + -ላ 'to her'). ርቱዕ 'right, fitting' is a predicate adjective, with ይሰግዱ a subjunctive 'that they worship'. ሰገደ 'bow, worship' takes ለ-; ለዘ ገብረ ኵሎ = 'to the one who made all', ዘ- being the relative. The long list is in the accusative (nouns ending in -ä, as in ሰማየ, ምድረ, ወርኀ, and plurals in -ት (accusative -ተ) such as ከዋክብተ, ደመናተ), all objects of ገብረ 'made'; each pair is joined by ወ-. The list recalls Genesis 1 and Psalm 148 (creatures, sun and moon, stars, lightning, clouds). Uncertain: ቢሐተ, ዐንጐጓተ and ፀዓዓተ are not known to me with confidence (without Dillmann), and ጸዳላት 'lights' and ሐርገጽ 'creeping thing' are likely but unchecked; ዐናብርተ is from ዐንበር 'whale, large sea creature'. ሠናያነ ወእኩያነ is an accusative plural of persons or things, 'good ones and bad ones'.

sentences.t: ሎቱ ፡ ለባሕቲቱ ፡ ንስግድ ፡ ይደሉ ፡ በፍርሀት ፡ ወበረዓድ ፡ በፍሥሓ ፡ ወበሐሤት ፤ እስመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚአ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ፈጣሬ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ወሰብእ ፡ ወውእቱ ፡ ይቀትል ፡ ወያሐዩ ፡ ወውእቱ ፡ ይቀሥፍ ፡ ወይሣሀል ፡ ዘያነሥኦ ፡ ለነዳይ ፡ እምድር ፡ ወያሌዕሎ ፡ እመሬት ፡ ለምስኪን ፡ ወያሐዝን ፡ ወያስተፌሥሕ ፡ ያዐርግ ፡ ወያወርድ ፤ ዓልቦ ፡ ዘይግእዞ ፡ እስመ ፡ እግዚእ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ወዓልቦ ፡ ዘይብሎ ፡ ምንተ ፡ ገበርከ ፤
sentences.l: To-him to-his-alone we-worship (it-is) fitting, in-fear and-in-trembling, in-joy and-in-gladness; for he lord-of all, creator-of angels and-man, and-he he-kills and-he-gives-life, and-he he-scourges and-he-has-mercy, he-who he-raises-him to-poor from-earth and-he-lifts-him from-ground to-needy, and-he-makes-grieve and-he-makes-glad, he-raises and-he-brings-down; there-is-not who he-restrains-him(?) for lord he of-all, and-there-is-not who he-says-to-him: what you-have-done;
sentences.i: It is right that we worship him alone, with fear and trembling, with joy and gladness; for he is Lord of all and the maker of angels and of people. He kills and he gives life; he scourges and he shows mercy. He raises the poor from the earth and lifts the needy from the ground; he saddens and he gladdens, he raises up and brings down. There is no one who can restrain him (?), for he is Lord of all, and there is no one who says to him, "What have you done?"
sentences.n: ሎቱ ለባሕቲቱ 'to him, to his aloneness' = 'to him alone' (ባሕቲት 'aloneness' with suffix). ንስግድ is a 1st-person plural subjunctive ('let us / that we worship') with ይደሉ 'it is fitting'. በ- is 'in, with' (manner: 'in fear'). ፈጣሬ መላእክት 'creator-of angels' is a construct chain. The paired verbs ይቀትል / ወያሐዩ ('kills / gives life', ያሐዩ causative of ሐይወ 'live') echo Deuteronomy 32:39 and 1 Samuel 2:6-8; 'raises the poor from the dust' is 1 Samuel 2:8 and Psalm 113:7. ዘያነሥኦ is a relative ዘ + imperfect with the object suffix -ኦ 'him', resumed by ለነዳይ 'the poor' (a pleonastic pattern). ዓልቦ 'there is not' (cf. አልቦ). እምድር is እም 'from' + ምድር 'earth' with the ም written once (cf. እመሬት 'from the ground'); the Hebrew of 1 Samuel 2:8 says 'dust', this text does not. ይግእዞ is uncertain: from a verb I take to mean 'restrain, hold back' (?), the same crux as አግአዞ in ch. 27 (rendered 'restrained (?)' there). ምንተ ገበርከ 'what have you done' echoes Job 9:12 and Daniel 4:35.

sentences.t: ወሎቱ ፡ ይደሉ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ ወአኰቴት ፡ እምኀበ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ወሰብእ ።
sentences.l: And-to-him it-is-fitting glory and-thanksgiving from-with angels and-man.
sentences.i: And to him belong glory and thanksgiving from angels and from people.
sentences.n: ወሎቱ ይደሉ 'and to him it is fitting' repeats the pattern of the previous sentence (ሎቱ ... ይደሉ), here with a noun subject: ስብሐት 'glory, praise' and አኰቴት 'thanksgiving'. እምኀበ is 'from (the side of)'; መላእክት ወሰብእ 'angels and man' repeats the pair used above. The sense-unit ends here at ።.

sentences.t: ወበእንተ ፡ ዘትብሊሰ ፡ ወሀበክሙ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕግ ፡ በአማን ፡ ተውህበት ፡ ለነ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እንተ ፡ ተፈጥረት ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ፍጥረት ፡ በምክረ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ፤ ወትእዛዞሂ ፡ አውረደ ፡ ለነ ፡ ጽሒፎ ፡ ከመ ፡ ናእምር ፡ ፍትሖ ፡ ወኰነኔሁ ፡ ዘሠርዐ ፡ በደብረ ፡ መቅደሱ ፨
sentences.l: And-concerning what you-say-indeed: he-gave-you ark-of law; in-truth it-was-given to-us ark-of God-of Israel, which she-was-created from-before all creation by-counsel-of his-glory; and-his-commandments-too he-sent-down to-us having-written, so-that we-know his-justice and-his-judgment, which he-established on-mountain-of his-sanctuary.
sentences.i: As for what you say, that he gave you the Ark of the law: truly, it was given to us, the Ark of the God of Israel, which was created before all creation by the counsel of his glory. And his commandments too he sent down to us in writing, so that we might know his justice and his judgment, which he established on the mountain of his sanctuary.
sentences.n: ወበእንተ ዘትብሊሰ: በእንተ 'concerning' + ዘ 'what' + ትብሊ 'you (fem.) say' (the Queen is addressed) + the contrastive -ሰ ('as for'). ወሀበክሙ 'he gave you' is her quoted claim (-ክሙ is 'you', plural). ታቦተ ሕግ 'ark-of law' is a construct (the form ታቦተ serves for both construct and accusative); ታቦተ አምላከ እስራኤል is another construct chain. ተውህበት is a passive (ተ- stem, 'was given'); ተፈጥረት 'was created' likewise, with feminine -ት agreeing with ታቦት, which is grammatically feminine (እንተ 'which', feminine). This is the book's Ark theology: the Ark is a pre-existent heavenly object, created before creation by God's counsel, not a human artifact; cf. Proverbs 8:22-23 on pre-existent wisdom. ወትእዛዞሂ 'and his commandments too' (ትእዛዝ + -ኦ 'his' + -ሂ 'too, indeed'); አውረደ 'he brought down' (causative of ወረደ 'descend'), ጽሒፎ is the gerund 'having written' (ጸሐፈ; CəCiCo like ርእዮ in ch. 27, subject God), so 'sent them down, having written them', and recalls the written tablets (Exodus 31:18). ደብረ መቅደሱ 'mount-of his-sanctuary' recalls Psalm 78:54 and Exodus 15:17. The ፨ ends the sense-unit.

sentences.t: ወትቤ ፡ ንግሥት ፡ እምይእዜሰ ፡ ኢይሰግድ ፡ ለፀሐይ ፡ አላ ፡ እሰግድ ፡ ለፈጣሬ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፤ ወይእቲ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ትኩነኒ ፡ እግዝእትየ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ወለዘርእየ ፡ እምድኅሬየ ፡ ወለኵሉ ፡ መንግሥትየ ፡ እለ ፡ እምታሕቴየ ።
sentences.l: And-she-said queen: from-now-indeed not-he-worships [3ms; sic] to-the-sun but I-worship to-creator-of sun, God-of Israel; and-she ark-of God-of Israel may-she-be-to-me my-lady, to-me and-to-my-seed after-me and-to-all my-kingdom, those from-under-me.
sentences.i: The Queen said: "From now on I will not worship the sun, but I will worship the maker of the sun, the God of Israel. And may she, the Ark of the God of Israel, be my lady, for me and for my descendants after me and for all my kingdom, those under my rule."
sentences.n: ወትቤ 'and she said' (ትቤ from the irregular verb ትቤ/ይቤ 'say'). እምይእዜሰ 'from now indeed' (እም 'from', ይእዜ 'now', -ሰ emphatic). Note: ኢይሰግድ is formally 3rd-person ('he/one does not worship'), not 'I'; it may be a slip or impersonal, but the sense is clearly the Queen's own vow, matching እሰግድ 'I worship' in the same sentence (?). ፈጣሬ ፀሐይ 'maker-of sun' is a construct. ትኩነኒ is the subjunctive/jussive 'may she be to me' (3rd fem. ትኩን + suffix -ኒ 'to me'); እግዝእትየ 'my lady' (the Ark is addressed as ruler, a theological move: she places her kingdom under the Ark). ለዘርእየ 'to my seed'; ለ- repeats before each beneficiary; እለ እምታሕቴየ 'those from under me'.

sentences.t: ወበእንተዝ ፡ ኢነ ፡ ረከብኩ ፡ ሞገሰ ፡ በቅድሜከ ፡ ወበቅድመ ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ፈጣሪየ ፡ ዘአብጽሐኒ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ወአስምዐኒ ፡ ቃልከ ፡ ወአርአየኒ ፡ ገጽከ ፡ ወአለበወኒ ፡ ትእዛዝከ ፨
sentences.l: And-therefore ኢነ(?) I-found favor in-your-presence and-in-presence-of God-of Israel my-maker, who he-brought-me to-you and-he-made-me-hear your-word and-he-showed-me your-face and-he-gave-me-understanding your-commandment;
sentences.i: For this reason I have found favor (?) in your sight and before the God of Israel, my maker, who brought me to you and let me hear your word and showed me your face and gave me understanding of your commandment.
sentences.n: ወበእንተዝ 'and for this reason' (በእንተ 'concerning' + ዝ 'this'). ኢነ ረከብኩ ሞገሰ is a crux: ኢነ is not a form I can parse. Read as a negative ('I have not found favor') it contradicts the four gifts that follow, and nothing marks a question, so I do not make it a question; it may be a corrupt printing of አነ 'I' (a guess), and I translate the clause as a plain statement 'I have found favor' (?), leaving ኢነ unrendered; ረከብኩ is 1st singular perfect, ሞገሰ accusative 'favor, grace' (cf. Genesis 18:3). በቅድሜከ 'in your presence' (ቅድም + ከ), በቅድመ is the construct form. ፈጣሪየ 'my maker'. The four causative (አ- stem) verbs with the object suffix -ኒ 'me' (አብጽሐኒ, አስምዐኒ, አርአየኒ, አለበወኒ) run in parallel: 'brought me, made me hear, showed me, made me understand'. 'See your face' recalls Genesis 33:10.

sentences.t: ወአተወት ፡ ቤተ ፡ ወወትረ ፡ ተሐውር ፡ ወትገብእ ፡ ወትሰምዕ ፡ ጥበቢሁ ፡ ወተዐቅብ ፡ በልባ ፤ ወውእቱኒ ፡ የሐውር ፡ ኀቤሃ ፡ ወይነግራ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘተስእለቶ ፡ ወይእቲኒ ፡ ተሐውር ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ወትሴአሎ ፡ ወያየድዓ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘፈተወት ።
sentences.l: And-she-settled(?) house and-continually she-goes and-she-returns and-she-hears his-wisdom and-she-keeps in-her-heart; and-he-also he-goes to-her and-he-tells-her all what she-asked-him, and-she-also she-goes to-him and-she-asks-him and-he-makes-her-know all what she-wished.
sentences.i: She settled (?) in a house, and continually she went and returned, and heard his wisdom and kept it in her heart. He also would go to her and tell her everything she had asked him, and she would go to him and question him, and he would let her know everything she wished.
sentences.n: አተወት is uncertain (?): I take it as 'she settled / made her home', with ቤተ 'house' in the accusative. The following imperfects (ተሐውር, ትገብእ, ትሰምዕ, ተዐቅብ) are habitual: 'she would go... return... hear... keep'. ጥበቢሁ is ጥበብ 'wisdom' (feminine) with the suffix -ሁ 'his' and the linking vowel -ኢ-, the same form as ስብሐቲሁ above; it is singular (the plural is ጥበባት). Keeping words in the heart echoes Luke 2:19. -ኒ after ውእቱ and ይእቲ is the 'also' particle. ተስእለቶ is read as a perfect 'she asked him' (the ተ- is unexplained (?)); ወትሴአሎ is an imperfect ('and she asks him'); ያየድዓ is a causative (አ- stem) verb 'make known': 'he makes her know' (?); the root is not identified here. ኵሎ ዘ- 'everything that'.

sentences.t: ወእምድኅረ ፡ ነበረት ፡ ፮ ፡ አውራኀ ፡ ፈቀደት ፡ ገቢዓ ፡ ብሔራ ፡ ወለአከት ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ትብል ፤
sentences.l: And-after she-stayed 6 months she-wished returning her-land and-she-sent to-him saying;
sentences.i: After she had stayed six months she wanted to go back to her country, and she sent word to him, saying:
sentences.n: ወእምድኅረ 'and after' (እም + ድኅረ 'behind'). ፮ is the numeral 6, written as in the text; አውራኀ is the plural of ወርኅ 'month', accusative (the length of time). ፈቀደት 'she wished' takes the gerund-like accusative ገቢዓ 'returning' (from ገብአ 'return'). ወለአከት 'and she sent' (ለአከ 'send', as in 'angel'/መልአክ); ኀቤሁ 'to him' (ኀበ + suffix). እንዘ ትብል 'while she says = saying' introduces the quotation, which carries on after the ፤.

sentences.t: ወአንሰአ ፡ እምፈተውኩ ፡ እንበር ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ወይእዘሰ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ እፈቅድ ፡ ገቢዓ ፡ ብሔርየ ፤ ወዘንተ ፡ ዘሰማዕኩ ፡ ይረስዮ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ዘይፈሪ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ልበ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ሰምዑ ፡ ምስሌየ ፤ እስመ ፡ ኢይመልእ ፡ እዝን ፡ በአፅምኦ ፡ ወኢይመልእ ፡ ዐይን ፡ በነጽሮ ፡ ጥበብከ ።
sentences.l: And-as-for-me [ʾä](?) if-I-wished I-would-stay with-you, but-now for-all people I-want returning my-land; and-this what I-heard may-he-make-it God, (it) which bears-fruit in-my-heart and-in-heart-of all-of-them who they-heard with-me; for not it-fills ear by-hearing, and-not it-fills eye by-seeing your-wisdom.
sentences.i: "As for me, if I wished I would stay with you (?), but now, for the sake of all the people, I want to return to my country. May God make what I have heard bear fruit in my heart and in the hearts of all who heard with me; for the ear is not filled with hearing, nor the eye with seeing your wisdom."
sentences.n: ወአንሰአ እምፈተውኩ እንበር is hard (?): አንሰ 'as for me' (አነ + -ሰ) with a stray አ; እምፈተውኩ is እም- + ፈተውኩ 'I wished' (the form is glossed 'if I wished' elsewhere), so I read it as 'as for me, if I wished I would stay (with you)'; 'as I wished' is the other possibility. ይእዘሰ 'but now' (ይእዜ + -ሰ). በእንተ ኵሉ ሕዝብ 'for the sake of all the people'. ይረስዮ is a jussive 'may he make it' (ረሰየ 'make, set') with ዘይፈሪ 'one that bears fruit' (ፈረየ 'bear fruit'); cf. the seed parable, Matthew 13:23. ልበ ኵሎሙ is construct ('heart-of all-of-them'). The last clause echoes Ecclesiastes 1:8 ('the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing'); the verb ይመልእ is imperfect, here with passive sense ('is filled'), and አፅምኦ / ነጽሮ are verbal nouns 'hearing', 'seeing'.

sentences.t: ወአኮ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ባሕቲታ ፡ ዘትመጽእ ፡ አላ ፡ ብዙኃን ፡ ይመጽኡ ፡ እምአህጉር ፡ ወበሓውርት ፡ እምቅሩብ ፡ ወእምርሑቅ ፡ እስመ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘተረክበ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ በጥበብ ፡ በውእቱ ፡ መዋዕል ፤
sentences.l: And-not she her-alone who-she-comes but many they-come from-cities and-by-ሓውርት(?) from-near and-from-far, for there-is-not (one) who-he-was-found like-him in-wisdom in-that days;
sentences.i: And it was not she alone who came, but many came from cities and by ሓውርት [ḥawrət] (?), from near and from far, for no one was found like him in wisdom in those days.
sentences.n: ወአኮ 'and not' negates the nominal clause (ይእቲ ባሕቲታ 'she by herself'); አላ 'but'. ዘትመጽእ 'who comes' is a relative with a feminine imperfect. ብዙኃን 'many' (plural) takes ይመጽኡ 'they come'. ወበሓውርት is uncertain (?): perhaps 'and by the journeys / roads' or a place term; I leave it. ከማሁ 'like him' (ከማ + ሁ). 1 Kings 4:34 and 10:1 (all peoples and kings came to hear Solomon's wisdom) lie behind this. በውእቱ መዋዕል 'in that days', መዋዕል being a plural form 'days, time'.

sentences.t: ወአኮ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ባሕቲቶሙ ፡ ዘይመጽኡ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ወዓዲ ፡ ዓራዊትኒ ፡ ወአዕዋፍ ፡ ይመጽኡ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ወይሰምዑ ፡ ቃሎ ፡ ወያነክሩ ፡ ጥበቦ ፡ ወይትናገሩ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ ወይገብኡ ፡ ብሔሮሙ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ያነክር ፡ ጥበቢሁ ፡ ወያነክር ፡ በዘ ፡ ርእየ ፡ ወሰምዐ ፨
sentences.l: And-not people their-alone who-they-come to-him, and-also beasts-also and-birds they-come to-him and-they-hear his-word and-they-marvel-at his-wisdom and-they-converse with-him and-they-return their-lands, and-everyone he-marvels-at his-wisdom and-he-marvels at-what he-saw and-heard;
sentences.i: And it was not people alone who came to him: wild animals and birds also came to him, and heard his word, and marveled at his wisdom, and talked with him, and went back to their own lands. And everyone marveled at his wisdom, and marveled at what he had seen and heard.
sentences.n: ባሕቲቶሙ 'their aloneness' = 'by themselves' (ባሕቲት + -ሙ). ወዓዲ 'and still, also'. ዓራዊትኒ 'wild beasts, also' (-ኒ the 'even, also' particle). The verbs are third-person plural imperfects used narratively (ይመጽኡ, ይሰምዑ, ያነክሩ 'marvel at', from አንከረ, ይትናገሩ 'converse', a reciprocal ተ- stem, ይገብኡ 'return'). Beasts and birds hearing Solomon recalls 1 Kings 4:33 (he spoke of beasts, birds, reptiles, fish) in the tradition that he understood animal speech (cf. Qur'an 27:16). ጥበቦ and ጥበቢሁ are 'his wisdom' written with different suffix forms. The sense-unit ends at ፨.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ለአከት ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትሖር ፡ ብሔራ ፡ ኀለየ ፡ በልቡ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ዘመጠነዝ ፡ ላሕይት ፡ ብእሲት ፡ መጽአት ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ እምአጽናፈ ፡ ምድር ፡ ምንተ ፡ ኣአምር ፡ እመ ፡ ይሁበኒ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ዘርአ ፡ በውስቴታ ።
sentences.l: And-when she-sent to-him that she-returns her-land he-thought in-his-heart and-he-said: of-such-size beautiful woman she-came to-me from-ends-of earth, what I-know if he-gives-me God seed in-her.
sentences.i: When she sent word to him that she would return to her country, he thought in his heart and said: "Such a beautiful woman has come to me from the ends of the earth. Who knows whether God may give me offspring by her?"
sentences.n: ወሶበ 'and when'. ከመ ትሖር 'that she go' (a subjunctive; ሖረ 'go'). ብሔራ 'her land' (ብሔር + -ኣ '3fs her'). ኀለየ 'he thought, pondered'. ዘመጠነዝ ('of such a size') + ላሕይት 'beautiful' (feminine adjective). እምአጽናፈ ምድር 'from the ends-of earth' is a construct; cf. 'queen of the south... came from the ends of the earth', Matthew 12:42. ምንተ ኣአምር 'what do I know?' is a rhetorical 'who knows?'; እመ ይሁበኒ 'if he may give me' (እመ 'if, whether'), ዘርአ 'seed' = offspring (Genesis 15:3).

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ ተብህለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መጽሐፈ ፡ ነገሥት ፤ ወሰሎሞንሰ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ መፍቀሬ ፡ አንስት ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወአውሰበ ፡ እምነ ፡ ዕብራዊያን ፡ ወግብጻዊያን ፡ ወከነናዊያን ፡ ወኢዶማዊያን ፡ ወኢዮባዊያን ፤ ወእምሪፍ ፡ ወኰርጐ ፡ ወድሚሲቅ ፡ ወሱርስት ፤ ወእምእለ ፡ ነገርዎ ፡ እለ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ላሕዮን ፤
sentences.l: As it-is-said in book-of kings; and-Solomon-indeed king lover-of women he, and-he-married from Hebrews and-Egyptians and-Canaanites and-Edomites and-ኢዮባዊያን(?); and-from ሪፍ(?) and-ኰርጐ(?) and-Damascus and-ሱርስት(?); and-from those they-told-him, who good their-beauty;
sentences.i: As is said in the Book of Kings: Solomon was a king who loved women, and he married women from among the Hebrews, Egyptians, Canaanites, Edomites and ኢዮባዊያን [ʾiyobawiyan] (?); and from ሪፍ [rif] (?), ኰርጐ [kʷärgʷä] (?), Damascus and ሱርስት [sursət] (?); and from those of whom they told him, whose beauty was fine.
sentences.n: በከመ ተብህለ 'as it was said' (ተብህለ passive, ተ- stem of ይቤ 'say'). መጽሐፈ ነገሥት 'book-of kings' is a construct (1 Kings 11:1-8 lists Solomon's foreign wives). ሰሎሞንሰ has the contrastive -ሰ. መፍቀሬ አንስት 'lover-of women' (መፍቀሬ is an agent noun, construct; አንስት 'women', plural). አውሰበ 'he married' (a causative of 'take as wife'), እምነ ... 'from among ...'. The peoples end in -ዊያን, the plural of the adjective -ዊ 'of' (ዕብራዊ Hebrew, ግብጻዊ Egyptian, ከነናዊ Canaanite, ኢዶማዊ Edomite). 1 Kings 11:1 gives Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, Hittites; ኢዮባዊያን may be a corrupt or different ethnic name (?). Uncertain: ሪፍ, ኰርጐ and ሱርስት are unclear to me as places or peoples (?); ድሚሲቅ is Damascus. ነገርዎ 'they told him'; ላሕዮን 'their (fem.) beauty' (ላሕይ + -ሆን '3fp their', contracted to -ዮን).

sentences.t: ወኮና ፡ ንግሥታት ፡ ፬፻ ፡ ወዕቁባት ፡ ፮፻ ፡ ወዘንተሰ ፡ ዘገብረ ፡ አኮ ፡ በዘምዎ ፡ አላ ፡ በኀልዮ ፡ ጥበብ ፡ ዘወሀቦ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወተዘኪሮ ፡ ዘይቤሎ ፡ ለአብርሃም ፡ ኣበዝኅ ፡ ዘርእከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኮከበ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ኆጻ ፡ ባሕር ።
sentences.l: And-they-were queens 400 and-concubines 600; and-this-indeed what he-did, not by-fornication but by-thought-of wisdom which he-gave-him God, and-remembering what he-said to-Abraham: I-will-multiply your-seed like star-of heaven and-like sand-of sea.
sentences.i: He had four hundred queens and six hundred concubines. Yet what he did was not done through fornication but through the reasoning of the wisdom God gave him, and in remembering what God said to Abraham: "I will multiply your descendants like the stars of heaven and like the sand of the sea."
sentences.n: ወኮና: ኮና is the feminine plural of ኮነ 'be' ('they were', agreeing with ንግሥታት 'queens', fem. pl.). ፬፻ is 4 × 100 = 400, ፮፻ is 6 × 100 = 600, kept as written; 1 Kings 11:3 has 700 wives and 300 concubines, so this is the book's own tradition. ዘንተሰ ዘገብረ 'this indeed, that which he did'. አኮ 'not'; በዘምዎ 'by fornication' (ዘምዎ is the infinitive of ዘመወ, CəCwo like ነጽሮ; -ዎ is part of the infinitive, not a suffix); አላ 'but'; በኀልዮ ጥበብ 'by the thought-of wisdom' (construct). ተዘኪሮ 'remembering' (a gerund of ተዘከረ). The quotation is Genesis 22:17 (cf. 15:5, 32:12): ኣበዝኅ 'I will multiply' (1st sg. causative), with ከመ ኮከበ ሰማይ 'like the star-of heaven'. The book defends Solomon's marriages as a plan to multiply Abraham's seed.

sentences.t: ወይቤ ፡ በልቡ ፡ ምንተ ፡ ኣአምር ፡ እመ ፡ ይሁበኒ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ተባዕተ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ በበ ፡ ፩ ፡ ለለ ፡ አሐቲ ፡ እምኔሆን ፤ ወበእንተዝ ፡ ተጠቢቦ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ ደቂቅየ ፡ ይረሱ ፡ አህጉረ ፡ ፀር ፡ ወይሠርውዎሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ያመልኩ ፡ ጣዖተ ።
sentences.l: And-he-said in-his-heart: what I-know if he-gives-me God male sons one-by-one, each one from-them; and-therefore being-wise he-did thus saying: my-sons they-inherit cities-of enemy and-they-subdue-them(?) to-those who they-worship idol.
sentences.i: And he said in his heart: "Who knows whether God may give me sons, one from each of them?" And so, in his wisdom, he acted as he did, saying: "My sons will inherit the cities of the enemy and will subdue (?) those who worship idols."
sentences.n: ተባዕተ ውሉደ 'male sons' (ተባዕት 'male', ውሉድ 'sons', both accusative). በበ ፩ ለለ አሐቲ is a distributive idiom: በበ 'each, by' + numeral ፩, ለለ 'for each' + አሐቲ 'one (fem.)'. ተጠቢቦ 'being wise' (gerund). ከመዝ 'thus'. ይረሱ 'they inherit' (ወረሰ 'inherit'); አህጉረ ፀር 'cities-of enemy' is a construct. ይሠርውዎሙ 'they ... them' is uncertain (?): I take 'subdue, put to flight'. ለእለ ያመልኩ ጣዖተ 'those who worship idols' (ለ- marks the object after the verb). Compare Genesis 22:17 ('your seed shall possess the gate of his enemies').

sentences.t: ወእሙንቱሰ ፡ ቀዳሚ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ነበሩ ፡ በሕግ ፡ ዘሥጋ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኢተውህቦሙ ፡ ጸጋ ፡ ዘመንፈስ ፡ ቅዱስ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-indeed first people they-were in-law of-flesh, for not-it-was-given-them grace of-Spirit Holy;
sentences.i: Those people were the earlier people, living under the law of the flesh, for the grace of the Holy Spirit had not been given to them.
sentences.n: ወእሙንቱሰ 'and they indeed' (-ሰ contrasts the older people with the Christians who follow). ቀዳሚ ሕዝብ 'first people' (ቀዳሚ adjective). ሕግ ዘሥጋ 'law of flesh' (ዘ- is the genitive linker) opposes ጸጋ ዘመንፈስ ቅዱስ 'grace of the Holy Spirit': Paul's contrast of the letter and the Spirit (Romans 7-8, 2 Corinthians 3). ኢተውህቦሙ 'it was not given to them' (passive ተ- stem + -ሙ).

sentences.t: ወለእለ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ክርስቶስሰ ፡ ተውህቦሙ ፡ ይንበሩ ፡ በአሐቲ ፡ ብእሲት ፡ በሕገ ፡ ሰብሳብ ፤
sentences.l: And-to-those after Christ-indeed it-was-given-them they-live with-one woman by-law-of ሰብሳብ(?);
sentences.i: But to those who came after Christ it was given to live with one wife, under the law of ሰብሳብ [säbsab] (?).
sentences.n: ወለእለ እምድኅረ ክርስቶስሰ 'and to those after Christ indeed' (እምድኅረ 'after'). ይንበሩ 'that they live' (subjunctive, from ነበረ 'sit, dwell'). በአሐቲ ብእሲት 'with one woman' (አሐቲ 'one', feminine). ሰብሳብ is uncertain (?): I take it as something like 'gathering, union' and so the law of marriage, but without Dillmann I cannot confirm. The rule of one wife (1 Timothy 3:2, Titus 1:6; Matthew 19:4-6) is the church norm.

sentences.t: ወሠርዑ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ሐዋርያት ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ነሥኡ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ ወደሞ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ አኀው ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ እሞሙ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ክርስቲያን ፡ ወአቡሆሙ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: And-they-established for-them apostles saying: those who-they-took his-flesh and-his-blood all-of-them brothers they, their-mother church and-their-father God;
sentences.i: And the apostles laid down for them, saying: "Those who have received his body and blood are all brothers; their mother is the Church and their father is God."
sentences.n: ወሠርዑ 'and they established' (ሠርዐ 'establish, ordain'); ሎሙ 'for them'. እንዘ ይብሉ 'saying'. ነሥኡ ሥጋሁ ወደሞ 'they took his flesh and his blood' means receiving communion (cf. Matthew 26:26-28). ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'house-of Christian' is the Church, a construct chain; here read 'Church' as the mother. The pronoun እሙንቱ 'they' makes the sentence nominal ('they (are) brothers'), and እሞሙ 'their mother', አቡሆሙ 'their father' are nouns with suffixes.

sentences.t: ወይጸርኁ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ዘተመጠዉ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብሉ ፡ አቡነ ፡ ዘበሰማያት ።
sentences.l: And-they-cry with Christ, those-who-they-received, saying: our-father who-in-heavens.
sentences.i: And those who have received it cry out together with Christ, saying: "Our Father in heaven."
sentences.n: ይጸርኁ 'they cry out' (ጸርሐ). ዘተመጠዉ 'those who took' is a relative ዘ with the ተ- stem of መጠወ 'give / receive'. አቡነ ዘበሰማያት 'our father who is in the heavens' is the opening of the Lord's Prayer, Matthew 6:9 (cf. Luke 11:2): the faithful share Christ's own prayer, which assumes they are brothers with one Father. No object is stated for ተመጠዉ; it is understood from the previous unit (his flesh and blood). ዘ- before በሰማያት makes the prepositional phrase relative: 'who (is) in the heavens'.

sentences.t: ወለሰሎሞንሰ ፡ ኢተሠርዐ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ በአንስት ፡ ወኢኮኖ ፡ ጌጋየ ፡ በአውስቦ ፤
sentences.l: And-to-Solomon-indeed not-it-was-ordained for-him concerning-women, and-not-it-was for-him fault in-marrying;
sentences.i: But for Solomon nothing was laid down about women, and it was no fault in him to marry.
sentences.n: ወለሰሎሞንሰ 'and as for Solomon indeed' (ለ- 'to', -ሰ contrastive). ኢተሠርዐ 'was not ordained' (passive). ሎቱ 'for him'. ኢኮኖ 'it was not for him' (ኮነ 'be' + suffix). ጌጋየ 'fault, error' (accusative); በአውስቦ 'in marrying' (በ- + the verbal noun of አውሰበ). The argument: the law of one wife belongs to Christians, so Solomon, before it, did not sin (compare Romans 4:15, 'where there is no law there is no transgression').

sentences.t: ወለመሀይምናንሰ ፡ ተውህቦሙ ፡ ሕገ ፡ ወትእዛዘ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢያብዝኁ ፡ አንስተ ፡ በከመ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ጳውሎስ ፡ እለሰ ፡ ብዙኀ ፡ አንስተ ፡ አውሰቡ ፡ መቅሠፍተ ፡ ኀሠሡ ፡ ለርእሶሙ ፡ ወዘሰ ፡ አውሰበ ፡ አሐተ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ኀጢአተ ።
sentences.l: And-to-the-believers-indeed it-was-given-them law and-commandment so-that not-they-multiply women, as he-said Paul: those-indeed many women who-they-married punishment they-sought for-themselves, and-who-indeed he-married one woman there-is-not sin.
sentences.i: But to the believers were given a law and a commandment not to take many wives, as Paul said: "Those who have married many women have sought punishment for themselves; but whoever marries one woman has no sin."
sentences.n: መሀይምናን 'believers' (a broken plural of መሀይምን). ከመ ኢያብዝኁ 'so that they not multiply' (negative subjunctive, causative of በዝኀ 'be many'). ጳውሎስ is Paul; the saying is not a verbatim quotation of the New Testament but a paraphrase in the spirit of 1 Timothy 3:2 and 1 Corinthians 7:2, 28. ብዙኀ አንስተ 'many women' (accusative). አውሰቡ 'they married' (perfect plural), ኀሠሡ 'they sought' (ኀሠሠ). ለርእሶሙ 'for themselves' (ርእስ 'head, self' + -ሙ). ዘሰ 'whoever indeed'; አልቦ ኀጢአተ 'there is no sin' (አልቦ takes the accusative).

sentences.t: ወሕገ ፡ እኅት ፡ ከላእነ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ወሊድ ፡ ይቤሉ ፡ ሐዋርያት ፡ በውስተ ፡ ሲኖዶስ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-law-of sister ከላእነ(?) which-concerning birth they-said apostles in-within Synod. ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.i: And the law concerning the sister, ከላእነ [kälaʾnä] (?), which has to do with childbearing, the apostles stated in the Synod.
sentences.n: ሕገ እኅት 'law-of sister' is a construct. ከላእነ is uncertain (?): I cannot analyze it with confidence (perhaps related to ከልአ 'forbid, hinder' with a suffix, or to the number 'two'), so the clause is only roughly rendered. ዘበእንተ ወሊድ 'which (is) concerning birth / childbearing' (ወሊድ from ወለደ 'bear'). ሲኖዶስ is Synodos (Greek synodos 'assembly'), the Ethiopic collection of apostolic and church-order canons attributed to the Apostles. The run of seven ፨ is the text's mark of a section break, kept with this last unit.
